schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The outward-facing voice of the system: where Cairn explains itself — and its design pattern — to people outside the build loop.
why: Telos 3 — share the tools, and the method, with others. A pattern others can't understand is a pattern they can't adopt or trust. This is deliberately NOT cairnmap: cairnmap answers 'what can I do here' to someone already inside the system, compiled from charters with zero inference; the press office answers 'how does this work, and why' to someone outside it, in authored prose. Different audience, different production mode — so it is a distinct component, not a corner of cairnmap.
state: v0 — founded 2026-07-15 with its first piece, IntentionBasedDesignForHumans.md. GREW INTO A SHELF 2026-08-11: FactSheet.md as the one measurement component every piece cites, CairnArchitecture.md as the spine, a twelve-document pattern series on one fixed skeleton (the measured failure / the pattern / how it is enforced / what it costs / what would falsify this / what is built and what is red), and INDEX.md as the shelf card that declares supersession and holds the known-stale table.

contents.IntentionBasedDesignForHumans.md: the founding piece — the intention-based design pattern explained for an intelligent outsider
contents.IntentionsBasedProgrammingClaudeFileTree: DRAFT (awaiting signature gate) — a worked example from the inside: CC explaining its own cross-session memory tree as an instance of the pattern (why-forced notes, pointer-not-proof, personal-vs-shared continuity). Companion to the founding piece; first-person voice.
contents.WorkflowDefinition.md: THE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR THE WORKFLOW (Akien, 2026-08-04): every step, its start, its end, its gate, and how a gate opens. If the workflow changes it lands here first and everything else follows. Scope is deliberately narrow — it owns WHICH steps exist and which gate stands where; a door's field list still compiles from that door's own charter (Law 5), and this file cites rather than re-authors it.
contents.GraphTreeMemoryTechnicalBrief.md: DRAFT (awaiting signature gate) — the memory system explained to an enterprise architect: graph trees as an inference cache (the three intake paths, and how nodes are deposited/indexed/retrieved), Stackable Learning Blocks and how they use that learning, the graph-tree structures and their database optimizations (owner-gated stores, per-tree tables, database.tree.leaf addressing, attractor-directed calving), and a map of the closest outside work. Written under Law 3: intention-level by request, with every measurement quoted with its numbers — including the ones that came out badly — and every unbuilt piece named as unbuilt. REVISED 2026-08-05 after Akien's first red-pencil pass, which found the error every internal cross-check had missed: the draft (and the ticket behind it, and the running store) collapsed NODE — the thing being remembered, carrying identity + provenance + standing, belonging to no tree — with LEAF — the thing indexing it, carrying the address database.tree.leaf plus vector, weights and two-way edges. `database.tree.leaf` is an ADDRESS, never an identity. Rewritten around that separation, together with the three results his correction produced: the shear runs on two-way links and therefore never touches a node (index maintenance cannot damage a record of truth), calving along dominant attractors CREATES the path a query walks rather than merely capping its cost, and the measured history that is the design's real provenance — 70,000 words / 2.5M bigram edges / over 30 seconds per edge update, with cost growing as the corpus grew. REVISED 2026-08-11 (ticket revision-with-receipts): the tenure loop moved from 'designed and not yet built' to BUILT AND PROVED 2026-08-09, carrying the measured standings (80 hypothesis / 3 earned / 1 refuted in library, 4 hypothesis in founding, n=88 on 2026-08-11) and the reading that three-of-88 after two weeks is the loop working rather than failing; the duplicate-drops-provenance defect the draft filed is recorded FIXED as predicted (provenance now appends as an attestation); falsifier 2 is marked SURVIVED ONCE and kept on the list, with its inverse named — an earned fraction that climbs fast would mean tenure is measuring popularity, not correctness.
contents.NoveltyDrivenGraphTreeExpansion.md: DRAFT (awaiting signature gate) — the paper: an architecture-and-protocol paper on two-tier novelty in self-extending retrieval. Its real content is a NEGATIVE result about our own design, measured 2026-07-27: a self-backfilling graph manufactures resolution, because nodes minted from a question are question-shaped and win the similarity race for it by construction. Formalizes the mint relation and the independence-corrected score, which forces a three-valued verdict (RESOLVED / PROVISIONAL / UNRESOLVED) — and reclassifies our own first success as PROVISIONAL. Companion to the brief; academic register; venues named. Rewritten around that separation, together with the three results his correction produced: the shear runs on two-way links and therefore never touches a node (index maintenance cannot damage a record of truth), calving along dominant attractors CREATES the path a query walks rather than merely capping its cost, and the measured history that is the design's real provenance — 70,000 words / 2.5M bigram edges / over 30 seconds per edge update, with cost growing as the corpus grew. REVISED 2026-08-11 (ticket revision-with-receipts): §4.2 gains a measured implementation-status note — built 2026-08-09, four properties enforced rather than described (no tenure on an echo of the birth question; m=2 distinct cross-questions; a refuter retires an earned node only on its own earned tenure OR a provenance authority, so a correction from outside can always outrank the corpus; lazy decay on read at a 14-day horizon, no sweeper) — and it says plainly that n=88 is an existence proof of the mechanism and discharges nothing in the §7 protocol. Falsifier 3 marked survived at n=88 and kept.
contents.INDEX.md: THE SHELF, and the second in-place exception beside WorkflowDefinition.md — a shelf whose cards do not match the shelf is worse than no cards. Declares what supersedes what (IntentionBasedDesignForHumans.md is OVERTAKEN as the pattern statement by PatternIntentionBasedDevelopment.md and RETAINED as the gentler on-ramp; retirement is Akien's signature, never the drafter's hand), carries the reading order, names the pairs that are deliberately distinct rather than duplicated (5/6/7 are mechanism vs storage vs device; 9/10 are the two peer substrates), and holds the KNOWN-STALE table — Law 3 turned on the shelf itself, because a signed stone is allowed to age but not to age silently.
contents.FactSheet.md: THE SINGLE MEASUREMENT COMPONENT for the whole folder, measured 2026-08-11 with the command that produced each number printed beside it. Founded because fifteen documents each carrying their own numbers are fifteen documents that drift apart: a piece CITES the sheet and never restates a measurement, so when the numbers move they move here once (Law 1 — the answered question becomes structure). Where a piece and the sheet disagree, the sheet is right and the piece is stale.
contents.CairnArchitecture.md: THE SPINE — the whole system for an architect or researcher who has never seen it: the measured decay that caused it, the thesis it tests, the Laws it runs on, the structures those Laws force, and what is and is not built. Deliberately NOT the deepest treatment of anything; §12 is the linked map into the twelve pattern documents, and its job is to make them make sense together. Every number cites FactSheet.md; every unbuilt thing is named unbuilt in the same sentence rather than in a footnote.
contents.PatternIntentionBasedDevelopment.md: Pattern 1 of 12 — intent, its voyage, and its proofs share an address; the filename forces the why. The current statement of the pattern the founding piece introduced.
contents.PatternGatesAndInspectors.md: Pattern 2 of 12 — enforcement IS gated ownership: no supervisor, no registry, deterministic filter stacks, and a human standing in the gate on purpose until a dial earns delegation.
contents.PatternWorkflowAndArtifacts.md: Pattern 3 of 12 — node classes and workflow strings parsed by the door that gates them, so a cursor is physics rather than a field someone maintains.
contents.PatternDevelopmentKnowledgeBase.md: Pattern 4 of 12 — the commons: if losing it loses knowledge, it is commons. Rulings, questions, troubles, ideas, slates, and why they are a repo rather than a database.
contents.PatternGraphTreeCaching.md: Pattern 5 of 12 — the MECHANISM: a miss resolves, deposits, and is never asked again; the three intake paths and the amortization argument. Cites GraphTreeMemoryTechnicalBrief.md for depth rather than restating its cost model.
contents.PatternTreeArchitecture.md: Pattern 6 of 12 — the STORAGE: separate the thing remembered (node: identity, provenance, standing, belongs to no tree) from the thing indexing it (leaf: the address database.tree.leaf, weights, two-way edges), with the embedding as the derived, regenerable layer between. Why a calve never touches a node, and the one-way vs two-way link cost that makes the shear affordable.
contents.PatternTheLibrarian.md: Pattern 7 of 12 — the DEVICE: owner of the trees, the shelf of frozen citable addresses, the walk, summarize-as-transducer, and the chat face whose rule is that the loop ANSWERS while the chat face ARTICULATES the answer. Its lead failure is ours: a greeting that returned a wall of resolution diagnostics with every proof green.
contents.PatternInferenceProxy.md: Pattern 8 of 12 — one door to every model, so metering is free and complete, and the cheapest answer is never the one you already have. Carries the measured 40.0% hit rate and 34.3% of tokens avoided, and the loopback rung cut categorically.
contents.PatternTheBus.md: Pattern 9 of 12 — communication has exactly one door, so observability is never a separate build. Four channels split by whether they are records of truth: a diagnostic may collapse into a coherent shape, a record channel refuses to (Law 7 as physics).
contents.PatternTheGroundLoop.md: Pattern 10 of 12 — one daemon in the whole system and all it does is beat; firing lives in the shim, which is what makes a probe the same unit whether it fires on a cadence or on its component's own trigger. Its founding failure was caught at n=1 and fixed by DELETION.
contents.PatternTheLauncher.md: Pattern 11 of 12 — superclaude: from parse to exec nothing may abort, and a diagnostic that needs a second run has already failed. The prime directive outranks the floor, because the tool is what you rebuild the machine with.
contents.PatternWhatIsPlanned.md: Pattern 12 of 12 — the roadmap published the way the code is published: claims with falsifiers, red until built, running, and inspected. Framed on Akien's own line that the whole system is a learning block whose inspector and memory are still his brain, and printing the 2026-08-05 'that's garbage' ruling as a Law 9 exhibit rather than hiding it. THE LEAST RELIABLE DOCUMENT IN THE FOLDER BY CONSTRUCTION, and it says so.
contents.OutreachPacket.md: DRAFTED 2026-08-11, awaiting the signature gate — NOTHING HAS BEEN SENT; sending is Akien's act. Who to show the work to and in what order (cognitive architecture -> neuro-symbolic -> program-synthesis/dynamic-graph-learning), ordered by WHO CAN FALSIFY US SOONEST rather than by prestige; the named people and venues from the 2026-08-04 conversation; and the DOCUMENT-COMPONENTS scheme Akien asked for — a per-field Part I of ~1,500 words, with Part II (the paper) and Part III (the fact sheet) shared VERBATIM, never re-cut per field, because three edits of the architecture section means three architectures and no way to tell which one anybody read. No compiler until three preludes exist (a compiler built at n=1 freezes that prelude's accidents into a schema). Opens with the caveat that protects the sender: the target list and the 'nobody does this' claim both come from ONE secondary source and no literature search — so every 'nobody does X' is a hypothesis about the field. Names what would count as signal IN ADVANCE, and names 'we solved that in 2003' as the best outcome on the list (Law 1 at the scale of a field).
contents.PreludeCognitiveArchitecture.md: PART I of three, prelude 1 of 3 — the architecture written for someone who thinks in impasses, chunks, activation and utility. Carries the SOAR correspondence (impasse -> subgoal -> chunk against miss -> resolve -> deposit), the ACT-R one (declarative chunk/base-level activation/spreading activation/utility learning against node/standing+decay/walk/tenure), and an OPEN one for Sigma that says plainly it could not be worked out from outside. States the single divergence — the resolver is an external, general model rather than the architecture's own problem-solving — and derives provenance-as-admission and standing from it. Then the part that earns the reading: the manufactured-resolution failure measured 2026-07-27, which their design never had to face because a chunk cannot be fabricated in response to the query. Ends with four questions, each better answered 'we did that' than 'how interesting', including whether tenure is the utility problem rediscovered with worse notation.

proof: each piece is a concept-piece: proved by human review (a quorum signature gate), not by the tester; it kicks back on rejection exactly like a red build. Obligation recorded in proofs/.
how_it_learns: By supersession, not in-place update: a concept-piece is a signed stone; it does not learn by editing. Corpus-level learning — a better piece replaces it, gated by the same quorum signature. Doesn't update in place, because a stone; its learning is at the shelf, not on the page. EXCEPTION, 2026-08-04: WorkflowDefinition.md learns IN PLACE — see two_production_modes.

Law 5 (intent shares an address — this folder carries its own why)
owner: Akien gates what ships outward from here (signature gate); CC drafts.
why_gated_by: THE MACHINE-READABLE HALF OF THE LINE ABOVE, added 2026-08-18 as a TRANSLATION of an owner sentence already on file — not a new decision. Akien holds the signature gate on what ships outward; CC drafts, and drafting is writing. The harbor's clearance gate (harbor_master.clearance.clear) requires exact membership for a forward crossing into a REST, and prose cannot gate: 22 of 24 beside-code charters carry an `owner` over 60 characters, so matching an actor against that sentence would be a substring scan going green for the wrong reason. Added here because ticket the-method-transfers-across-substrates berths in this component and would otherwise refuse at PROVED — the same wall `launchers` hit earlier today. POPULATION, MEASURED THE SAME DAY: 41 of 56 charters in class-space still lack this and will hit the same wall at the end of their next voyage; that owes its own ticket and this fix does not discharge it. WHAT IT DOES NOT CHANGE: the ownership, or the fact that PROVED does not mean sent.
provenance: born by a hand-run intent nexus on 2026-07-15 — the /intent skill was installed but not yet loaded into the session, so the resolver occupied the nexus by hand (the role-replacement staircase at step zero). First non-code node-class exercised in the build.
two_production_modes: Recorded 2026-08-04 as a distinction, not a conflict. Pieces here are SIGNED STONES that learn by supersession — a shipped explainer must not change silently under its readers. WorkflowDefinition.md is a LIVING DEFINITION and is edited IN PLACE, because drift between it and the workflow is the exact defect it exists to prevent. The whys are opposite and both hold; what they share is this folder's audience (Telos 3 — share the method), which is why it berths here rather than beside a single component: the workflow spans every component and so has no one code address.
learns: It does not; it is documentation — authored content, not a learning system.
